name: Coherent

eyebrow.en: Coherent Corp. · Common stock · Saxonburg, Pennsylvania
eyebrow.zh: Coherent · 普通股 · 宾州萨克森堡

title.en: AI optics growth, paid for up front.
title.zh: AI 光学高增长，先投入后回报。

lede.en: Coherent makes optical transceivers, indium phosphide lasers and industrial lasers. Datacenter & Communications is now 79% of revenue and grew 59% last quarter, and management targets a $3B revenue quarter by the end of FY27. To get there it is spending heavily on laser capacity, which has turned free cash flow negative.
lede.zh: Coherent 生产光模块、磷化铟激光器和工业激光器。数据中心与通信业务已占营收 79%，上季增长 59%，管理层目标在 FY27 结束前实现单季 30 亿美元营收。为此公司大举投资激光器产能，自由现金流已转负。

s.en: Q1 FY27 · date not yet announced
s.zh: FY27 第一季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. From its 52-week low the stock roughly quadrupled to $440, then fell about 30%.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。股价从52周低点约涨四倍至 $440，之后回落约 30%。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Coherent's fiscal year ends June 30; FY22 is II-VI before it bought Coherent in July 2022 and took its name. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。Coherent 财年截至6月30日；FY22 为 II-VI 在 2022年7月收购 Coherent 并更名之前的数据。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 债务/EBITDA · 一年前 2.0 倍

p.en: Data center revenue rose 66% YoY in Q4, and management expects more than 80% YoY growth this quarter. 1.6T transceivers ramp through 2027.
p.zh: 第四季数据中心收入同比增 66%，管理层预计本季同比增逾 80%。1.6T 光模块在 2027 年持续放量。

p.en: Internal InP laser output doubles YoY by the end of Q1 FY27, a quarter early, and more than doubles again by end-2027. A 6-inch wafer gives four times the output of a 3-inch one at half the cost.
p.zh: 内部磷化铟激光器产能将在 FY27 第一季末同比翻倍（提前一季），2027 年底前再翻倍以上。6 英寸晶圆产出是 3 英寸的四倍、成本减半。

p.en: Co-packaged optics revenue starts in the December quarter, and the optical circuit switch market estimate doubled to over $4B.
p.zh: 共封装光学收入将于12月季度开始贡献，光路交换机市场规模估计翻倍至逾 40 亿美元。

p.en: FY26 operating cash flow was only $80M against $1.1B of capex, so free cash flow was about −$1B. A third InP site is planned for the first half of 2027.
p.zh: FY26 经营现金流仅 8000 万美元，资本开支 11 亿，自由现金流约 −10 亿。第三个磷化铟工厂计划于 2027 年上半年启用。

p.en: Industrial revenue fell to $431M from $511M a year earlier as Coherent leans into AI.
p.zh: 随公司转向 AI，工业收入由一年前的 5.11 亿美元降至 4.31 亿。

p.en: InP capacity is the bottleneck; any slip in yields or the ramp caps revenue. The stock is about 30% below its high, so position sizing matters.
p.zh: 磷化铟产能是瓶颈，良率或爬坡受阻将限制营收。股价较高点低约 30%，仓位控制很重要。

p.en: Guide: $2.2–2.4B revenue, 39.5–41.5% non-GAAP gross margin, EPS $1.85–2.05.
Co-packaged optics is expected to start contributing.
p.zh: 共封装光学预计开始贡献收入。

p.en: Management aims for a quarter above $3B of revenue by the end of FY27.
p.zh: 管理层目标在 FY27 结束前实现单季营收逾 30 亿美元。

sources: Q4 FY26 call: InP capacity and $3B target
Price, market cap and beta: Yahoo Finance and Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Coherent Corp..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Coherent Corp. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q1 FY22 to Q4 FY26. Coherent's fiscal year ends June 30. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第一季至 FY26 第四季共 20 个季度。Coherent 财年截至6月30日。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Coherent used to produce modest free cash flow: most quarters from 2023 to 2025 brought in $24–137M, with a few small negatives. FY26 reversed that: operating cash flow fell to $80M for the year as inventory and receivables grew with AI demand, while capex rose to $1.1B, so free cash flow was about −$1B, including −$486M in Q4.
read.zh: Coherent 过去自由现金流不大：2023 至 2025 年多数季度为 2400 万至 1.37 亿美元，偶有小幅为负。FY26 情况逆转：随 AI 需求增长，库存与应收款增加，全年经营现金流降至 8000 万美元，资本开支升至 11 亿，自由现金流约 −10 亿，其中第四季 −4.86 亿。

read.en: Capex stays high while Coherent doubles indium phosphide output and builds a third site for the first half of 2027. I assume $500–550M of capex a quarter and operating cash flow recovering toward $400M as working capital catches up, which still leaves about −$800M over four quarters. The $2.6B of cash covers that, but leaves little room for buybacks or faster debt paydown.
read.zh: 在磷化铟产能翻倍并于 2027 年上半年建成第三个工厂期间，资本开支仍将维持高位。我假设每季资本开支 5–5.5 亿美元，经营现金流随营运资金回落逐步回升至约 4 亿，四季合计仍约 −8 亿。26 亿现金足以覆盖，但回购或加速还债的空间有限。

p.en: 6-inch lines in Texas and Sweden, plus a third site planned for the first half of 2027. Capex was $556M in Q4 alone.
p.zh: 德州与瑞典的 6 英寸产线，另计划于 2027 年上半年建第三个工厂。仅第四季资本开支就达 5.56 亿美元。

p.en: Inventory and receivables rise with datacenter growth, which is why operating cash flow lags profits.
p.zh: 库存与应收款随数据中心增长而上升，这是经营现金流落后于利润的原因。

p.en: Net debt fell by about $0.5B in FY26, cutting leverage to 0.7× from 2.0×.
p.zh: FY26 净负债减少约 5 亿美元，杠杆由 2.0 倍降至 0.7 倍。

p.en: Q1 FY27 is guided to $2.2–2.4B of revenue, with data center growth above 80% YoY.
p.zh: FY27 第一季营收指引 22–24 亿美元，数据中心同比增逾 80%。

p.en: 6-inch InP wafers at half the cost of 3-inch should lift gross margin as they ramp.
p.zh: 6 英寸磷化铟晶圆成本为 3 英寸的一半，放量后应推高毛利率。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes new borrowing, debt repayment, divestitures and buybacks.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入新增借款、偿债、资产出售与回购。

extraNote.en: FY2022 figures are II-VI before it acquired Coherent in July 2022.
extraNote.zh: FY2022 数据为 II-VI 在 2022年7月收购 Coherent 之前的数据。
